release_name: UNCANNY v0.20.0-alpha.1 - ELYSIUM Engine 4.5 - Adaptive Realism

adaptive_realism_tiers.C: trustworthy depth only; conservative spatial lighting; no temporal history
adaptive_realism_tiers.D: no trustworthy depth; tonal/spatial fallback only

api_notes.d3d11: strongest current Adaptive Realism route; capability-scored depth and optical flow where available
api_notes.d3d12: supported; conservative fallback when trustworthy generic scene depth is unavailable
api_notes.d3d10_10_1: compatibility route; capability depends on available evidence
api_notes.d3d9: supported legacy route; conservative fallback when trustworthy depth is unavailable

limitations: Real-game visual and performance acceptance remains title/GPU/driver specific.
D3D12 and D3D9 do not claim depth-aware GI when trustworthy generic scene depth is unavailable.
Native-PC-game REVENANT asset replacement remains experimental.
DLSS 5 is NVIDIA-specific even though Adaptive Realism itself is vendor-neutral.
